Based on the healthcare Q&A matches, it appears that pulpotomy is considered a viable alternative to root canal treatment for teeth with vital pulps in the short term. However, its long-term effectiveness and suitability are still being evaluated.

Pulp chamber pulpotomy is typically performed as an emergency or urgent procedure to save a tooth from further damage when other treatments like root canal therapy may not be sufficient. In some cases, it may require multiple procedures, such as pulpotomy followed by root canal treatment in the future.

While there is limited clinical evidence to support its use as a permanent treatment for every case of pulp chamber pulpotomy, this technique offers a potential alternative approach that can be further developed and refined for future applications.
